verdict.rationale: Token2 ships an open-source CLI (fido2-manage) for local device configuration and a PowerShell bulk-enrollment script that automates pre-registering keys into Microsoft Entra ID via Microsoft's Graph API — some scriptable, agent-drivable provisioning exists. However, there is no evidence of Token2's own documented enterprise API for ordering or assigning keys to users, and probes confirm no OpenAPI/swagger spec exists on their site. missing for 10: a Token2-owned ordering API, an assignment/fleet-management API, and any documented enterprise API surface beyond third-party (Microsoft) integration scripts.
